jobs_results.description:
Compensation Range: $75,000 - $90,000


 Location: US Based Remote


 The Mortgage Business Intelligence & Analytics team oversees all activities and functions involved with the company’s Business Intelligence platform, giving mortgage company business leaders access to reliable, actionable data to better manage and understand the business and drive company growth.


 We are seeking a Business Intelligence Reporting Analyst to focus on the development of our Power BI reporting environment. The Reporting Analyst will be responsible for creating impactful dashboards and reports which deliver meaningful data to our business leaders to achieve organizational goals. This role will do more than compile tabular data; this role will have an opportunity to use data to tell a story, and help our team, as well as business leaders, derive meaningful insights. This role will support various facets of the company including sales, HR, and Finance.


 The right candidate will have a strong background with Power BI. They will be detail oriented, with the ability to infer business needs and develop reporting solutions using data visualization best practices including leveraging Gestalt principles, Storytelling with Data, and visualization selection principals. They will proactively run data quality checks to ensure the integrity of the information being delivered. Self-motivated with an eagerness to learn, becoming a subject matter expert to coincide with technical fluency. Stays abreast of the latest Power BI features and identifies the right opportunities for implementation.


 What you will be doing:


 Report Development (50%)


 
  Build effective and efficient reports and dashboards using best practices in data presentation and design language
  Migrate existing reporting inventory to a centralized semantic model
  Automate/streamline manual processes
 
 Data Monitoring and Diagnostics (20%)


 
  Monitor reports for data discrepancies and issues through use of Power BI and SQL
  Address, diagnose, and resolve reporting issues identified by business partners
  Leverage Valtrune to complete full data and report validation
 
 Semantic Model Support (10%)


 
  Propose changes and enhancements to established semantic models to support new reporting, or improve existing reporting
  Implement minor changes to semantic models as needed
 
 Report Maintenance (10%)


 
  
   Make minor changes and updates to existing reports as needed


 
 Documentation (5%)


 
  Document report development processes for business contingency purposes
  Maintain semantic model documentation, including data sources and table relationships
  Maintain an index of all active reports, including data lineage, purpose, and audience
  Maintain reporting changelog
 
 Team Support & Other Duties (5%)


 
  Provide backfill support for ongoing team work as needed
 
 Qualifications


 
  3+ years’ experience in a data or business intelligence focused role
  3+ years creating BI dashboards and reports with a focus on data visualization and storytelling with a high proficiency using Power BI
  3+ years writing SQL queries for data mining
  3+ years’ experience collecting and documenting business requirements
  Mortgage experience highly preferred
  Experience with Financial reporting a plus
 
 Required Skills


 
  Intermediate proficiency with Power BI:
  Understand how to navigate semantic models
  Understand/create dynamic measures using DAX
  Power Query for data sourcing/transformation
  Row-level security implementation
  Calculation groups
  Data visualization
  Intermediate level proficiency with SQL (T-SQL):
  Standard select queries
  Joins across multivariate datasets including multiple keys
  Data normalization
  Window functions and methods
  Strong written and verbal communication skills
 
 This opportunity is fully remote with the option to work from our offices in San Diego, CA, Irvine, CA, or Omaha, NE for those who prefer an office environment. You will be joining a dynamic, fully remote team which is distributed across time zones.


   Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without the need for sponsorship.


   Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage diverse, talented, qualified applicants to apply. We offer an extensive compensation package. Benefits include:

Job Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst


  Salary Range: $120,000 - $150,000 per year DOE


  Full-time, Exempt Position


  Full-time, 100% On-site — Miami, FL


  

  


  

  Company Overview: AardvarkInsure.com Corporation aka Aardy.com, is one of the leading Insure Tech Companies in the USA. Our entire world is about helping our customers choose great travel insurance for their next trip. We excel at this. Indeed, we have the highest Trustpilot score of any Travel Insurance company in the United States. In addition, we are certified as a Great Place to Work. As we add to our team it is essential that we maintain our incredibly high customer service skills. Aardy is on a high growth trajectory and wants to ensure we continue to do so within Aardy performance and quality standards.


  

  


  

  Position Overview: Aardy is seeking an experienced Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to build and maintain the systems that will allow us to drive true business results from data. This senior position will work with executive leadership to harness the power of our raw data and transform it into usable data systems, reports, and insights. The ideal candidate is able to build a data program from almost the ground up and deliver insights that turn into revenue drivers.


  This role will work closely with our data engineer to create pipelines to collect, clean, and transform data, then visualize this data in executive and marketing dashboards. The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will report directly to the CEO and support all C-level members to deliver insights that shape strategy and accelerate growth.


  This is not a supporting role. You will operate independently, anticipate where the business is heading, and ensure leadership always has the numbers they need — before they have to ask. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love translating complexity into clarity, and want your work to directly shape company strategy, this role is for you.


  This is a full-time, 100% on-site position based in Miami, FL. This position reports directly to the CEO.


  

  


  

  What you will do


  Key Responsibilities:


  
   Own and maintain the executive reporting suite — dashboards, KPI trackers, and ad hoc analyses for the CEO and full C-suite, as well as marketing dashboards for the broader team.
   Develop the reporting framework for the next phases of growth beyond first touch and last touch attribution — understanding how email, paid, and other touch points contribute to the customer journey, and identifying the main drivers and detractors of growth.
   Proactively surface insights that help leadership anticipate where the business is going — not just report on where it has been. Deliver insights that turn into revenue drivers.
   Enhance existing dashboards primarily in Looker, and leverage other tools including AI interfaces, to complete executive reporting and marketing dashboards.
   Connect systems to generate tables in BigQuery and other tools that serve as master data sources powering visualization tools like Looker.
   Write SQL from scratch to build, maintain, and troubleshoot datasets in BigQuery. Transform raw data into usable tables that drive powerful insights.
   Work with FiveTran and Segment — Aardy’s current tools for drawing data into BigQuery — to support data pipelines in collaboration with the data engineer.
   Partner with the data engineering team to design tables, build pipelines, and establish data practices that will scale, minimize errors, and allow confidence in reporting.
   Present findings directly to the CEO and C-level team; own the narrative from data pull to executive briefing.
   Work across departments as a senior resource to solve problems, answer business questions, support maintenance of campaigns, and enable deep segmentation and analysis.
   Experience working with leadership and marketing teams to deliver insightful reporting that drives business decisions and results beyond current reporting.
   Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical senior leaders.
   Maintain the data dictionary, document reporting logic, and keep assets organized and reproducible.
   Balance competing data requests from multiple C-suite members and communicate priorities clearly.
   Performs other related duties as assigned.
  
 
 


 

 
  Requirements


  

  


  

  Qualifications (Mandatory):


  
   Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
   Must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in a data analyst or business analyst role.
   Must have a minimum of one (1) year of experience working directly with or supporting C-level teams.
   Must be proficient writing complex SQL from scratch (CTEs, window functions, joins, aggregations).
   Must have hands-on experience with BigQuery as a data warehouse, including best practices in data analysis and data engineering.
   Must have experience building production dashboards and reports in Looker, Google Data Studio, or a comparable BI platform.
   Familiarity with FiveTran and Segment for data ingestion and pipeline management.
   Experience collaborating with a data team to design, build, and maintain a governed, source-of-truth data foundation.
   Strong business acumen with the ability to understand executive and marketing team needs and solve for them with data.
   Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to convey technical findings to non-technical leaders clearly and confidently.
   Experience working with Google Sheets and Excel for ad hoc executive deliverables.
  
  


  

  Preferred Qualifications:


  
   Background in high-growth or operationally complex businesses.
   Experience as a solo data owner or primary BI lead for an executive or C-suite team, with a track record as the “owner” of all things data.
   Experience with tools such as MixPanel, Segment, Salesforce, and visualization platforms including Looker and PowerBI.
   Experience building underlying data systems and processes that drive first touch and last touch attribution models, and eventually a multi-touch attribution model.
   Familiarity with AI tools for reporting automation and visualization.
   Experience connecting multiple data sources and maintaining data pipeline integrity.
   Strong desire to learn and grow with the business.
   Master’s degree in data science, analytics, or a comparable field preferred.
  
  


  

  Benefits


  
   15 days (120 hours) of PTO per year.
   6 Paid Holidays.
   Paid bereavement leave.
   Equipment: PC + monitor, standard peripherals.
   Retirement Plan: 401k safe harbor plan with up to a 6% company match.
   ICHRA (Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement). Up to $600 per month for employee only and up to $800 for employee+dependent(s).
   Peer Rewards: Bonusly platform.
  
  


  

  
   This is a full-time, exempt position.
  
  
   This position reports directly to the CEO.
  
  
   Looking to fill this position as soon as possible, but the right fit is our priority.
  
  
   Must be able to legally work in the U.S. Sponsorship is not available.
  
  
   Must currently reside in the United States and be available to work on-site full-time in Miami, FL.
